# TizenTube icon

`app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/tizentube_icon.webp` is TizenTube's launcher icon, taken from the TizenTube Android app (`io.gh.reisxd.tizentube.cobalt`) and resized to 240x240 WebP.

TizenTube is by [reisxd](https://github.com/reisxd/TizenTube) and is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. The license text is in `LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt` next to this file.
